verdict.rationale: An IP office running online search, register, and e-filing services could plausibly offer a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes web UIs (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister, DPMAdirektWeb), downloadable desktop filing software (DPMAdirektPro), and paper or fax routes. Nothing documents an API, let alone one with parity to the UI.
